verses.70:43: يَوۡمَ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعࣰ ا كَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ نُصُبࣲ يُوفِضُونَ

en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
meaning: The root وَفَضَ (wafaḍa) covers three distinct senses per Ibn Fāris, the first being haste — أوفض إيفاضا: أسرع, to hurry; the Quranic usage is of hastening forward.
meaning_source: Derived from the classical dictionaries (chiefly Maqayis al-Lugha, Ibn Faris d.1004) held in lexicon_full/
